title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Issues Concerning the Filing and Causes of Action in State Compensation Cases
keywords_en: state compensation; people's court on state compensation cases
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Issues Concerning Case Filing and Causes of Action in State Compensation Cases

Fa [2012] No. 33

Higher People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the Higher People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

The Supreme People's Court's Provisions on Case Filing in State Compensation Cases (hereinafter referred to as the "Case Filing Provisions") and the Supreme People's Court's Provisions on Causes of Action in State Compensation Cases (hereinafter referred to as the "Causes of Action Provisions") were adopted at the 1537th meeting of the Judicial Committee of the Supreme People's Court on December 26, 2011, and shall come into force on February 15, 2012. The Supreme People's Court's Interim Provisions on Case Filing in Criminal Compensation and Non-Criminal Judicial Compensation Cases (for Trial Implementation) and the Supreme People's Court's Interim Provisions on Causes of Action in Criminal Compensation and Non-Criminal Judicial Compensation Cases (for Trial Implementation) shall be repealed simultaneously. In order to correctly apply the Case Filing Provisions and the Causes of Action Provisions, to effectively protect the right of citizens, legal persons, and other organizations to lawfully exercise their right to claim state compensation, and to properly handle the acceptance of cases, notice is hereby given on the relevant issues as follows:

1. Regarding the examination of case filing in state compensation cases

Where a compensation claimant files a compensation application with the people's court which is the compensation obligor, or files a compensation application with the compensation committee of a people's court in accordance with Articles 24 and 25 of the State Compensation Law, the case filing department of the people's court receiving the application shall be responsible for the examination of case filing. The work of receiving petitions related to state compensation shall be handled by the case filing and petition department of the people's court.

2. Regarding relevant matters concerning the examination of case filing

Where a compensation claimant files a compensation application with the people's court which is the compensation obligor, the case filing department of the people's court receiving the application shall examine the application in accordance with Article 4 of the Case Filing Provisions. If, upon examination, the application meets the conditions for case filing, the case filing department shall assign a case number, serve a notice of case acceptance on the compensation claimant within five days from the date of case filing, and, after assembling all the relevant case file materials involved in the compensation application, transfer them together to the compensation adjudication body of that court for handling. The time for assembling the case file materials shall be deducted from the time limit for making a compensation decision.

Where a compensation claimant files a compensation application with the compensation committee of a people's court in accordance with Articles 24 and 25 of the State Compensation Law, the case filing department of the people's court receiving the application shall examine the application in accordance with Articles 5 to 8 of the Case Filing Provisions. If, upon examination, the application meets the conditions for case filing, the case filing department shall assign a case number, serve a notice of case acceptance on the compensation claimant, the compensation obligor, and the reconsideration organ within five days from the date of case filing, and serve a copy of the state compensation application or the Application for Compensation Registration form on the compensation obligor and the reconsideration organ. If the compensation obligor is a people's court at the next lower level, the case filing department shall also, after assembling all the relevant case file materials involved in the compensation application from the next lower level court, transfer them together to the compensation committee of that court for trial. The time for assembling the case file materials shall be deducted from the time limit for making a compensation decision.

Where, upon examination, the two types of cases mentioned above do not meet the conditions for case filing, the case filing department of the people's court receiving the application shall, within seven days, make a decision of non-acceptance, affix the seal of the people's court, and serve the decision on the compensation claimant within ten days from the date of the decision.

3. Regarding the application of causes of action in state compensation cases

Where the compensation application submitted by a compensation claimant falls within the circumstances specified in Article 1 of the Case Filing Provisions, the cause of action shall be determined in accordance with the Causes of Action Provisions. When applying Items 6 to 10 of the Causes of Action Provisions, the cause of action shall generally be determined by selecting one item based on the specific circumstances of the compensation application. For example, if the compensation application involves the unlawful use of police weapons or instruments resulting in the death of a citizen, the cause of action shall be compensation for death caused by unlawful use of police weapons or instruments; if the compensation application involves abuse resulting in physical injury to a citizen, the cause of action shall be compensation for injury caused by abuse.

Where the compensation application submitted by a compensation claimant involves two or more judicial acts of the same compensation obligor and corresponds to the same right, and should be heard together, multiple causes of action may be determined in parallel. For example, if the compensation application involves both unlawful criminal seizure and unlawful criminal recovery, the cause of action shall be compensation for unlawful criminal seizure and recovery; if the compensation application involves both unlawful preservation and erroneous enforcement, the cause of action shall be compensation for unlawful preservation and erroneous enforcement.

Any new circumstances or issues arising in the application of the Case Filing Provisions and the Causes of Action Provisions shall be promptly reported to the Supreme People's Court.

January 13, 2012
